def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 5 for v in row))
    def components(r0, r1):
        seen=set(); out=[]
        for r in range(r0,r1):
            for c in range(w):
                if grid[r][c] and grid[r][c] != 5 and (r,c) not in seen:
                    color=grid[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                    while stack:
                        y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                        for dy in (-1,0,1):
                            for dx in (-1,0,1):
                                if dy == 0 and dx == 0: continue
                                z=(y+dy,x+dx)
                                if 0 <= z[0] < h and 0 <= z[1] < w and z not in seen and grid[z[0]][z[1]] == color:
                                    seen.add(z); stack.append(z)
                    out.append((color,cells))
        return out
    upper=components(0,divider)
    lower=components(divider+1,h)
    top_color, top_cells=max(upper,key=lambda item:max(c for r,c in item[1]))
    _, bottom_cells=lower[0]
    top_r=min(r for r,c in top_cells); top_c=min(c for r,c in top_cells)
    bottom_r=min(r for r,c in bottom_cells); bottom_c=min(c for r,c in bottom_cells)
    top_h=max(r for r,c in top_cells)-top_r+1; top_w=max(c for r,c in top_cells)-top_c+1
    bottom_h=max(r for r,c in bottom_cells)-bottom_r+1
    bottom_out_r=bottom_r-(divider+1)
    dest_top_r=bottom_out_r-top_h
    dest_top_c=bottom_c+(max(c for r,c in bottom_cells)-bottom_c+1-top_w)//2
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h-divider-1)]
    for r,c in top_cells: out[dest_top_r+r-top_r][dest_top_c+c-top_c]=top_color
    for r,c in bottom_cells: out[r-(divider+1)][c]=grid[r][c]
    return out
